literal_gloss: Read-by-me of-Theodore of-Antioch on-behalf of-Basil against Eunomius in treatises twenty-five. He-is in expression not wholly brilliant, in thoughts and arguments very dense, and by scriptural at-once accredited testimonies. Almost word-for-word of-the of-Eunomius treatises the refutation he-makes, ignorant utterly both of outward learning and much more of our theology through many proofs showing. The of-Mopsuestia become bishop this is, I-think.
source_text: Codex 4 Greek from photius_bibliotheca_greek_lock.txt (Bekker 1824, pp. 3; closeout-4b transcription)
